moves_nothing: no pin, gate or floor is written by this file

sheet_a_reconciliation.authority: the prior five batches (v4's frozen split)
sheet_a_reconciliation.why: sheet A ran its own bucket-stratified split over its own 960-location draw; a location it shares with a prior batch was assigned twice, by two draws over two different sets. Honouring sheet A's stamp there would put a v3/v4 TRAINING location into the eval side and inflate the baseline.

v4b_seed_band.note: every seed selected on THIS eval side; the staged max is optimistic against this band.

score_scale.why: CORN marginals are calibrated to the training prior, so the two heads' p_ge3 are not on one scale and no raw-threshold comparison appears in this report.

pass_rate_at_the_live_gate.read_as: volume, NOT quality — the two rates are what makes the volume matching necessary, not a comparison in themselves.

by_deployed_gate.note: v4b is read at v3's VOLUME, never at v3's threshold — the two marginals are calibrated to different training priors.

winner_rule.rule: v4b wins iff (a) no pre-declared no-worse arm is significantly worse than v3 (95% paired-bootstrap CI on the delta not entirely below 0) AND (b) on the motivating arm at least one metric is significantly better and none is significantly worse. Otherwise v3 keeps candidacy.
winner_rule.multiplicity_note: clause (a) is a conjunction over 18 arm x metric cells; at 95% per cell the chance one crosses by luck alone is material, so read `failures` before reading `pass`.
winner_rule.adoption: NOT decided here. BUILD != FLIP: adoption is a separate prompt after Matt reads this verdict.
